images.title: A factor of 2 means always even
images.purpose: Shows that 4m + 2q can be rewritten as 2 times something, so it is even for every integer m and q.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. Two large expressions in rounded boxes, left and right, joined by one arrow, with the factor 2 highlighted.
images.exact_structure: Left: a teal (#0072B2) outlined rounded box holding 4m + 2q. A thick dark arrow pointing right. Right: a teal (#0072B2) outlined rounded box holding 2(2m + q), with the leading 2 drawn large inside a reddish purple (#CC79A7) circle. Under the circle, the label factor 2. Under the right box, centred, the label always even. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered

images.takeaway: 4m + 2q is 2(2m + q), so 2 is a factor and the value is always even.
images.description: Shows that 4m + 2q can be rewritten as 2 times something, so it is even for every integer m and q.
images.context: 4m + 2q = 2(2m + q). With m = 4, q = −9 the value is −2, even.

image_decisions.why: Rewriting with 2 pulled out as a factor is the whole idea; a two box picture shows it cleanly.
